test.reason: Tests are flat by behavior surface so individual files can run directly with bun test test/name.test.tsx.

src/app.reason: App orchestration modules stay together when they share command, keyboard, lifecycle, and UI plumbing.

src/ui.reason: Top-level UI keeps shared controls discoverable; larger feature overlays live in src/ui/overlays.

src/themes.reason: Themes stay discoverable as small palette, family, builder, and registry modules in one directory.
